Do you have a history of seizures or epilepsy?

Have you traveled outside the country in the past year?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Generalized tetanus (Clostridium tetani neurotoxin, presumed from an unapparent or unrecognized entry wound, in a patient without up-to-date tetanus immunization)

Alternatives:
1. Strychnine poisoning (false-negative toxicology, or subacute exposure)
2. Acute dystonic reaction (despite no reported neuroleptic or antiemetic exposure)
3. Localized tetanus of the cephalic type with facial involvement
